messages:
Elaine (sec-eng): Uploaded a draft Audit Validation Kit for the upcoming schema changes — link: https://docs.redwood.ai/audit-validation-kit (drive). Pack includes: sample payloads, SIEM mapping CSVs, a small validation API, and a customer FAQ draft. Please skim for gaps.
Samir (eng-sre): Looking now. Quick q: we renamed principal_id -> actor.id in the spec, right? need to confirm backward compat strategy.
Elaine (sec-eng): Correct — canonical field is `actor.id`. We will accept `principal_id` as an alias for 6 months and emit a deprecation warning in the validation API. Add note in the changelog.
Maria (prod-comms): For customer-facing assets, can we include 3 small runnable examples: (1) basic app audit, (2) KMS key rotation event, (3) RBAC change followup? Customers like end-to-end.
Dan (platform): Agree on examples. Also add a sample SIEM transform for Splunk and a mapping for Datadog logs. I'll drop a sample transform later today.
Priya (support): Customers will ask about signed events and KMS fingerprints. Do we have an official field name for key id / fingerprint?
Elaine (sec-eng): Use `kms.key_id` (string) and `kms.fingerprint` (sha256 hex) — documented in kit. For signed events we include `signature.scheme` and `signature.value`.
Samir (eng-sre): Tiny nit: ensure the validation API accepts both `kms.key_id` and legacy `key_id` locations while we migrate. Also add a smoke test script for the Dedicated flow.
Elaine (sec-eng): Good call. Validation API will map legacy fields in preflight. Smoke test script: `scripts/smoke_validate.sh` included.
Elaine (sec-eng): Posting a small sample audit event (in kit):
```json
{
  "event_type": "policy.rbac.change",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-19T20:03:12Z",
  "actor": { "id": "u-12345", "email": "alice@example.com" },
  "target": { "type": "role", "id": "admin" },
  "change": { "action": "grant", "permission": "secrets.read" },
  "kms": { "key_id": "projects/pm/keys/key-7", "fingerprint": "b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184" },
  "signature": { "scheme": "rsa-sha256", "value": "BASE64SIG==" }
}
```
Elaine (sec-eng): And curl to validate locally: `curl -X POST https://audit-validate.internal.redwood/v1/validate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @sample.json`
audit-validate-bot: validation-kit v0.2 published to internal bucket (s3://redwood-internal/audit-kit/v0.2) — changelog attached.
Dan (platform): Thx. A couple of edge cases to call out in the doc: (1) batched events with mixed schemas, (2) events emitted by proxies that strip headers. I'll add a troubleshooting section.
Maria (prod-comms): I'll draft the customer email and a short playbook for how customers can run the kit against their SIEMs. Need copy by EOD Friday.
Priya (support): Can we add a small triage flow for vuln-related audit events? e.g., what to surface to SOC vs. what goes to SRE.
Elaine (sec-eng): Yes — adding a short triage matrix: severity mapping -> who to notify (SOC, SRE, Customer Success).
Samir (eng-sre): Action items for me: add Dedicated smoke tests, update validation API to accept legacy aliases, and create a small helm chart for on-prem validation hook. ETA Tue.
Elaine (sec-eng): Action items for me: finalize kit docs, publish customer-facing ZIP (with sample payloads + README + SIEM mappings), and sync with Maria for messaging. ETA Mon.
Maria (prod-comms): I'll request legal review for wording around deprecation window.
Priya (support): I'll prepare an internal Q&A for support triage.
Elaine (sec-eng): If no blockers, I'll push v0.2 -> public preview tomorrow and announce in #announcements. Please leave any review comments in the Drive doc before 17:00 PT. :thumbsup:
